title: Use GPT-5.6 Ceres for No. Series Copilot
summary: The No. Series Copilot feature now uses the GPT-5.6 Ceres managed deployment instead of GPT-4.1 for content provenance compliance.
key_points: Deployment switched from GPT-4.1 to managed GPT-5.6 Ceres for the No. Series Copilot
Only the deployment getter is modified; authorization and other logic remain unchanged
Both intent/tool selection and number-series generation stages reuse the same Azure OpenAI instance
No schema, permission, or prompt changes
Model output quality and latency may change pending evaluation
quote: Move Suggest No. Series with Copilot from GPT-4.1 to the managed GPT-5.6 Ceres deployment for content provenance compliance.
